title: Investigation launched after racist abuse incident at Rochdale nightclub
excerpt: A woman has been filmed hurling racist abuse at a nightclub bouncer in Rochdale, prompting an investigation by Greater Manchester Police.
body:
Daisy Johnson, 21, was filmed directing racist abuse towards a nightclub bouncer in Rochdale on Saturday night. The footage shows Johnson imitating a monkey and using derogatory language.

Greater Manchester Police have confirmed they are investigating the incident, which has raised concerns about racism in the area. The footage has circulated widely on social media, prompting outrage among local communities.

The incident occurred at a nightclub in Rochdale, specifically Ko Ko Lounge, on 20 October 2026. Authorities are urging anyone with further information to assist with the investigation.
